name: Keto Salisbury Steak with Mushroom Gravy Skillet
why: Ground-beef Salisbury steak patties seared and simmered in mushroom gravy - all stovetop skillet, batch-scalable like meatballs to 14 servings (form/sear/simmer). Published 463 cal / 7.75g carb / 28g protein per serving sits squarely in the middle of the 400-650 cal, <=35 carb band, and it is structurally low-carb (meat + mushroom gravy, no rice/pasta/potato). Distinct from the accepted keto-cheeseburger-skillet, low-carb-stroganoff-skillet and steak-bites entries. Board maps ground beef, egg, onions, parmesan, mushrooms, beef broth, coconut-aminos, dijon-mustard, ketchup; almond flour + xanthan gum are genuine board gaps (good pricer-lane flags), keto ketchup subs to tracked ketchup/sugar-free ketchup on rewrite.
